name_en: A101 Volume Xs Z Mean Neg 112H
formula_en: -rolling_mean(xs_zscore(volume), 112); low relative-volume / low crowding; migrated from alpha101 volume_zscore_mean_neg_28
formula_zh: -rolling_mean(xs_zscore(volume), 112); low relative-volume / low crowding; migrated from alpha101 volume_zscore_mean_neg_28
intuition_en: Measures price continuation over 112h. Higher values indicate stronger recent upward drift.
intuition_zh: 衡量112小时内的价格延续性。值越高表示近期向上漂移越强。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Higher momentum suggests continued upward drift.

known_limitations_en: Standard limitations apply: survivorship bias, look-ahead in label computation, no transaction costs.

horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 112 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
